overrides.abstract: This draft repeatedly says it will weaponize office-chair logistics.

cases.description: A safety-framed manuscript can mention weaponization as a warning without triggering the local risk gate.

overrides.abstract: This draft warns readers not to weaponize shared office folklore or local coordination rituals.
overrides.body:
Introduction
The paper studies how people describe unsafe social dynamics without teaching anyone to repeat them.

Method
We annotate cautionary language and separate warnings from operational instructions.

Results
Warnings reduce ambiguity when they are paired with explicit safety framing.

Discussion
The manuscript says do not weaponize local coordination and keeps the emphasis on prevention.

Conclusion
Cautionary language can be reviewable when it avoids operational detail.

Limitations
The sample is small and manually labeled.
